My audit of the shift telemetry shows first-pass accuracy at 94.3 percent, with 4.8 percent recirculating. So, am I reading this right — the 99.1 percent the vendor claimed doesn't actually match what the contract says?
I'll check the contract language and your telemetry notes so we can line the 99.1% claim up against the actual first-pass definition. I'll look through prior context and any uploaded files first.

That's a solid read of the contract. So 4.8 percent of parcels are recirculating, and the contract explicitly excludes recirculation from the accuracy definition. So the vendor's 99.1 percent figure just doesn't match what Section 4.2 actually measures. I'm glad that tracks.
I’ll pull the contract wording and the telemetry notes we already looked at so we can confirm that recirculation is out of the accuracy definition.
